extraActions.description: Declarative action buttons appended after children. Lets consumers add actions without replacing the messageActions slot component.

message.description: The message this bar belongs to. Injected by ChatMessage (from its existing useMessage subscription); pass explicitly in standalone usage.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

slotDescriptions.actions: The component that renders the actions.
